records.title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2
records.creator: Court of Appeal (Civil Division), England and Wales
records.description: Published text of the Court of Appeal judgment concerning possession and adverse possession of Great House Farm, with the appeal limited to the farmhouse and garden. This is a public legal transcription, not the original sealed court file. The judgment recounts earlier events as part of its reasons; those passages should not be counted as independent corroboration of the underlying historical documents.

acquisition.retrieval_note: Located through a web search and read in part in this work session; full line-by-line citation audit remains outstanding.

limitations: A court judgment is an authoritative source for what the court decided and the reasoning it published; it is not an independent original source for every earlier event recounted in the judgment.
The appeal was limited to the farmhouse and garden; the judgment states that the possession order for the rest of the farm was not challenged on appeal.
This source does not, by itself, determine whether wider institutional coordination, fraud, deliberate concealment, or planning/heritage maladministration occurred.
records.status_note: Located source. The site's separate archival monitoring workflow is responsible for recording a Save Page Now attempt and any confirmed snapshot URL.

records.title: Heneb Historic Environment Record GGAT02038s — Great House Farm, Llandough
records.creator: Glamorgan-Gwent Archaeological Trust / Heneb Historic Environment Record (record credits include RCAHMW material)
records.description: The public HER entry identifies Great House Farm, Llandough (PRN 02038s), locates it at NGR ST16707335, classifies it as a post-medieval farm, and summarizes architectural observations, the partial 1974 survey, the December 1988 demolition, reported finds, and linked archaeological records. The page states a compiled date of 21 August 1991 and a last-updated date of 29 September 2026. These are statements in the HER page; the underlying survey, source notes, excavation archives and the events described remain distinct artifacts requiring separate provenance.

records.title: Heneb Historic Environment Record GGATE003872 — Land at Great House Farm, Llandough
records.creator: Glamorgan-Gwent Archaeological Trust / Heneb Historic Environment Record
records.description: The public HER event page is titled “Land at Great House Farm, Llandough” and identifies the event as an archaeological evaluation. Its summary says BP Properties commissioned GGAT fieldwork concerning redevelopment; it describes human remains in trenches 3 and 4, house remains in trench 7, rubble and medieval material in trenches, and recommendations to avoid or record archaeological deposits. These are statements made in the HER event entry; the signed assessment, site records, context sheets, plans, photographs and response by the planning authority should be catalogued independently.
records.completeness: Public HER event page read; no matching Cedwyn local copy was verified in this session. Original 1990 assessment and primary field archive are separate artifacts. No timestamped Internet Archive capture confirmed here.

records.title: Coflein / National Monuments Record of Wales NPRN 20182 — Great House Farm site
records.creator: Royal Commission on the Ancient and Historical Monuments of Wales (RCAHMW)
records.description: The Coflein site record for NPRN 20182 describes a demolished farmhouse of limestone construction and says it was demolished in December 1988. It records that internal details suggested a seventeenth-century house while other features suggested a possibly medieval core, and attributes the site-file notes to Richard Suggett. The page also points to the separate Heneb/Archwilio record 02038s and separately identified NPRN 802090 cemetery. This is the institutional description of a site record; it must not be treated as the underlying Suggett note or as a determination of title or planning legality.
records.completeness: Public Coflein record read; underlying registered file and source notes not fully examined here. The listed local archive path appears to be for an older Llandough Roman-villa page, not NPRN 20182; it is not asserted as a copy of this source.

acquisition.retrieval_note: The current public Coflein page for NPRN 20182 was read via search result. The older local archive directory presently visible is for the Roman villa page, so no matching local copy of NPRN 20182 is confirmed.

pinpoints: Source: Site File notes by Richard Suggett
limitations: The date and content reflect the Coflein site's published record and should be checked against the original site-file notes.
The page distinguishes the farmhouse site NPRN 20182 from the cemetery record NPRN 802090; their spatial and archaeological relationship needs the relevant plans and excavation reports.
The page does not decide freehold title, possession, listing law, planning compliance or responsibility for demolition.
